issues.title: Move the site to Astro and Vercel
issues.body:
Pages would be written in Markdown and built by Astro, and Vercel would give each PR a preview link, so adding a page is quick and every change can be seen before it merges.

`src/`, `astro.config.mjs`, `package.json`, `vercel.json`
